sentences.text: ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Aakash Kukkar

For Respondent(s) : Mr. SS Rajpurohit, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 13/02/2024 The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.228/2022 of Police Station Mahila Thana, District Sriganganagar for the offence punishable under Sections 307, 324,
323, 498A, 342 IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Mahila Thana, District Sriganganagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He has preferred this bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

Counsel for the petitioner submits that co-accused namely Ved Prakash & Smt. Neelam have already been released on bail by this Court and the case of the present accused-petitioner is similar to those of the co-accused.
Moreover, victim Priyanka and her mother Pushpa have been examined before the trial court as PW-1 & PW-2 respectively and they have been declared hostile.

The accused-petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case [2024:RJ-JD:7370] (2 of 2)
[CRLMB-1717/2024] will take sufficient long time to be concluded.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
